card.name: Space after Grade in dose-adjustment tables
card.fires_on: The blank space token right after the word Grade (or a number or unit) in oncology dose-modification tables, just before the grade number. Also fires on a few nearby words in these tables, such as clinically or the ing of dose-limiting.

modes.label: Space after Grade
modes.description: A space between the word Grade and its number in toxicity-grade dose rules.

modes.label: Space before a number or unit
modes.description: A space before a number or unit in recovery times or dose reductions.

modes.label: Words inside adverse-reaction management
modes.description: Words within phrases about managing adverse reactions, such as monitor as clinically indicated or dose-limiting.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like side effects, adverse and toxicity.
card.plain: It marks the spot in dose-adjustment tables where a side-effect severity grade is being given.
